answer: Timed Whisper Relay. Each new agent identity must originate a unique signed whisper that propagates across a basalt-anchored ledger of relay nodes, and it only counts if relayed by distinct operators within a rolling window. Identity weight equals verified relay depth, not balance. Duplicates collapse to one marble-stamped record. An attacker needs many independent operators, real latency, and sustained relay work per identity—costly in coordination and time, not cash.
